title: The 9 best AI tools for social media management in 2026
summary: I researched and tested every AI tool for social media management that I could get my hands on, and these are the best.
body_markdown:
**App**


**Best for**


**Standout feature**


**Pricing**


Buffer


Tailoring posts for each channel


AI Assistant that detects your channel and adapts post output accordingly


Free plan available for 3 channels and 10 posts; paid plans from $5/month/channel


Publer


Value for money


Built-in AI image generation plus a chat assistant connected to your last 30 days of performance


Free plan available for 3 accounts; paid plans from $5 for the first channel and $4/month per additional channel


FeedHive


Content recycling and conditional posting


Scans post history for recycling candidates and auto-adds comments based on engagement rules


From $15/month


ContentStudio


Staying on top of content topics


Content feed with topic tracking, sentiment signals, and influencer monitoring


From $19/month


Predis.ai


Creating all post content with AI


End-to-end post creation (text, images, video) in a single platform with goal tracking


From $19/month


StoryChief


Planning and executing a multi-channel strategy


William AI canvas that scrapes your site and builds a full content strategy from scratch


Free plan available for analytics only; paid plans from $22/month


Eclincher


Automating engagement with AI


AI agents that triage DMs and comments by urgency and sentiment, with private knowledge base support


From ~$134/month


Hootsuite


All-in-one for growing businesses


OwlyWriter AI with copywriting frameworks (AIDA, PAS) plus a unified DM inbox across all platforms


Free 30-day trial; from $199/user/month


Sprout Social


Advanced AI-powered analytics and social listening


Listens to millions of messages daily; AI summarises sentiment trends with real customer voice quotes


Free 30-day trial; from $199/user/month
